_purpose: Frozen price vector (D23). Cost is NEVER stored as an observed number: the ledger stores tokens (the invariant physical quantity, from each API's usage field), and every dollar figure is recomputed as tokens x this vector. To re-derive all economics under different prices, copy this file, edit prices, and re-run analysis/stats.py with --price-vector <file>. The version used for the paper's primary analysis is frozen at preregistration.
version_history: v2026-07-30 = Study-1 frozen vector (entries below through meta-llama unchanged, byte-identical subset); v2026-08-23-wave = superset extended with the 10 wave generator models of Protocol 12 (D48), verified 2026-08-22/23. Study-1 reproducibility unaffected: the original subset is intact. v2026-09-21-judge-price-correction = added zai-org/GLM-5.2 (1.40/4.40), the judge that actually executed from 2026-07-31 onward (D33 within-family replacement for GLM-4.7), and annotated GLM-4.7 / Mistral-Small-24B as superseded; NO price value changed and judge prices are never consumed by any analysis (judge cost excluded from T-EGR, D15/D23), so all published economics are unaffected (D62).
role: primary (Study-1 part frozen at Phase 0; wave extension frozen at Protocol-12 registration OSF jg49x)
unit: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, standard (non-discounted, non-batch) tier
